The four phases

Each phase builds on the last.

Scroll through the phases. Every one ends with something you can see and respond to.

01 / 04 · Week 1

Discovery & Strategy

We dive deep into understanding your business, challenges, and goals.

  • Initial consultation and needs assessment
  • Business process analysis
  • Goal setting and KPI definition
  • Technology stack evaluation
  • Project roadmap creation

02 / 04 · Weeks 2-6

Development & Creation

We build your solution with regular check-ins and updates.

  • Custom feature implementation
  • AI model development where it fits
  • Integration with existing systems
  • Quality assurance testing
  • Regular progress updates

03 / 04 · Weeks 6-7

Testing & Launch

Rigorous testing makes sure everything works before going live.

  • Comprehensive system testing
  • User acceptance testing
  • Performance optimization
  • Deployment to production
  • Team training and handoff

04 / 04 · Ongoing

Support & Optimization

Continuous monitoring and improvements after launch.

  • Performance monitoring
  • Regular updates and improvements
  • Technical support
  • Feature enhancements
  • Quarterly strategy reviews
